fieldNotes.ownership: Roster sourced this from a stale Hyster GM plant list. The Martel bakery-mix plant was a General Mills facility 2001-2016 but was sold to The Mennel Milling Company in 2016; current signage at the gate reads 'Mennel'. The physical building audited is the correct site for the roster's 'Martel OH plant' entry.
fieldNotes.geocode: Roster geocode moved 22.7km but landed correctly on the actual Martel industrial plant; the city-level coords were far off and the geocoder corrected them. Confirmed by web search (4136 Martel Rd) and Street View signage.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link swing/sliding gate where the gravel-paved truck driveway meets Main St (SV captured 2023-09); yellow bollard at the gate. Perimeter chain-link fencing runs along the property frontage and around the parking lots.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at or beside the gate in any Street View heading; the gate is an unstaffed fenced opening, hence remoteGs=true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard inside the gate between the entrance and the dock aprons provides ample internal holding room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: NW building face shows ~6-8 trailers backed into dock doors; additional doors on the SW/rail side. Total estimated 10-25 band; exact count uncertain from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NE corner has a marked trailer drop area with ~8-10 parked trailers; additional trailers staged near the NW dock apron.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail tracks run along the SE side of the property with rail cars positioned against the building (grain/flour handling).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large industrial complex; counted as one campus. buildingCount of 3 reflects the main plant building plus 2 smaller attached/adjacent structures.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting (small unincorporated community of Martel) but along a road with utility lines and a rail corridor; cellular coverage likely adequate - low-confidence false.
